notes.title: The Diofield Chronicle Update ver1.20
notes.content:
[list]
[b][*]Additional new story content starring Waltaquin Redditch[/b]Follow the events from Waltaquin joining the Blue Fox up to Chapter 5 and see the story unfolding from her perspective.
 
[b][*]New gameplay mechanics, maps, missions and boss[/b]Featuring new events that present Waltaquin’s thoughts and deliberations as options for the player. Explore new maps, take on new missions and fight the fearsome new boss “Behemoth”.
 
[b][*]New equipment and skills[/b]The new “Magic Tome” equipment type and the “Necrotiem” skill that can be used with it open up new tactical possibilities, not seen in the original game.
 
[b][*]New difficulty level and play mode unlocked after completing the game[/b]This update introduces the new “Very Hard” difficulty level that offers players an even more satisfying challenge, as well as an extra mode where the difficulty level is pitched at players who have completed the main story.
 
[*] Adjustments to game balance in certain areas.
[/list]

notes.title: Free Update Coming March 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42088068/138953d8aedded745369e35a6d329bb9443c2495.png[/img]
A free update is coming to The DioField Chronicle in March 2023, which includes a new story, a new weapon, new skills, and additional challenges!

[list][*][b]NEW STORY[/b][/list]
Play through a new scenario as Waltaquin and use powerful Necromancy skills with the newly added Grimoire. Summon Skeletal Knights and fearsome Skeletal Dragons to force your enemies into submission!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42088068/0a3c13c6aa3a5575ce17e31854cb632d24c9b739.png[/img]

[list][*][b]NEW BOSS[/b][/list]
Face off against the mighty Behemoth!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42088068/3b804d6a6f53b08a6ad10cc5a7aee65b378d3299.png[/img]

[list][*][b]EXTRA MODE[/b][/list]
The free update will include a new difficulty option for New Game+.
A new difficulty level, Very Hard, will also be added.

Follow [url=https://twitter.com/DiofieldGame]The DioField Chronicle on Twitter[/url] for more updates!
